items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Duke didn’t write it, he stole it from King Oliver.

ctx.x: They don’t care. You can say anything you want about Benny. He made a lot of money, so did Duke make more money than Benny ever did, but he spent it all. But you can’t take that approach. You have people today who write about — leading authorities — on Duke Ellington write about “Creole Love Call” as if Duke wrote it. Duke didn’t write it, he stole it from King Oliver. And this isn’t anything anyone can even question. You go back and listen to the Oliver record, which is called “Camp Meeting Blues,” it’s not…
Is it political correctness gone amok?
